hook: Your plane window can go dark without any shade.
title: Plane Windows That Darken at a Button
description:
Boeing 787 Dreamliner windows have no pull-down shades. Instead the glass dims when you press a button, and you can watch it darken. It is real technology on real passenger planes.

#Shorts #Technology #Boeing787
comment_prompt: Shade or button? Shade or button

scenes.narration: Your plane window can go dark without any shade.
scenes.headline: NO WINDOW SHADE

scenes.narration: There is no plastic shade to pull.
scenes.headline: NOTHING TO PULL

scenes.narration: The glass slowly turns dark blue.
scenes.headline: THE GLASS DARKENS

scenes.narration: You can watch the darkening happen.
scenes.headline: WATCH IT HAPPEN

scenes.narration: Press again and the sky comes back.
scenes.headline: SKY COMES BACK

scenes.narration: A window that dims itself. Tomorrow: another strange place.
